title: Introduction to Synthetic Biology
description: Fundamental theory and techniques pertaining to genetic engineering, bioinformatics, and synthetic biological design, as well as industry-relevant principles such as biomanufacturing, ethics, and the current biotechnology entrepreneurial landscape.
